audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was named but never given numbers, and Depth Charge's homing behaviour was absent from the full layer.
audit.why: Dredge Line is an immobilising hook on 14/13/12/11/10s, so Riposte returns a stun; Depth Charge is 120/100/80s, homes on its target and knocks up, which cancels your Vital chase. Riptide is only 7s at rank 1 — chip you cannot play around.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the real timers and the parry-into-stun rule.

audit.why: 14s at rank 1 is a long, punishable window — the single most useful number in this lane.
missingInteractions claims Dredge Line denies your Lunge. It displaces rather than grounds — pulling you together does not disable Q. Not asserted.

edits.before: Q a vital and back out — free chip he cannot answer. Identify how Nautilus contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours outright: Vital true damage ignores his tank stats and he has no poke or kill threat to answer with.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Nautilus must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: It evens out at 3: you win with his 14s hook down, but a landed Dredge Line into his Staggering Blow root flips the trade.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Nautilus carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: His full chain — hook, Staggering Blow root, then Depth Charge — out-locks one Riposte, so never fight him with his jungler near.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line: matchup-defining — His only engage. Riposte it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dredge Line: 14s at rank 1 — parry it and the hook comes back as a stun. Step up the moment he misses. - Depth Charge: 120s at rank 1, and it homes; if Riposte is spent, do not commit. - Riptide is 7s — chip you ignore.

notes: missingInteractions listed 'Nautilus can deny your mobility (Lunge) with Dredge Line'. Dredge Line displaces, it does not ground, so I did not write that claim anywhere. The genuinely decisive interaction — Riposte parrying an immobilising hook or knockup returns a stun — was already correct in the content layer and is now mirrored into the full layer.
